_README: Every image on the site is a named slot here. Files live at public/media/{id}.jpg and, for a separate mobile crop, public/media/{id}.mobile.jpg. A missing file renders a designed placeholder, never a broken image. Aspect is width:height. Priority: hero = LCP candidate, high = above the fold on its route.
